summary: Full regression on Quotation Management module (backend + frontend). 15/15 pytest cases pass covering dashboard, list, create with DB + manual items, math validation, update recompute, status patch (incl invalid), send via email (mocked), send via whatsapp (mocked), PDF (200 + %PDF header), duplicate, convert-to-order (order_number + status=accepted + converted_order), delete draft + super_admin delete of non-draft. Frontend Playwright covered: login, /admin/quotations dashboard (KPI cards + By Status + Top Customers), list page (search, status filter, data-testids), create-quotation flow (customer picker, catalog product picker, manual line, live totals, save), detail page (customer + company snapshot, line items, terms, summary with amount-in-words, HISTORY log incl 'Sent via email'), PDF button opens application/pdf popup, Convert-to-Order (button disabled after conversion, history logs 'Converted to Order ...', quote status becomes Accepted), Duplicate (creates draft and navigates to /edit), Quotation Settings page (prefix/digits/start/validity/save all present + save toast), AdminUsers edit modal exposes Designation (au-designation), Signature Image (au-signature) and Use-signature-on-quotations toggle (au-use-signature). Everything works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: quotations.py: PDF endpoint (GET /{qid}/pdf) mutates history and calls _persist on every download — a simple PDF preview will accumulate 'PDF generated' history entries; consider logging only on explicit export or deduping.

quotations.py list_quotations: check_expiry() flips in-memory status but does NOT persist the flip in DB — 'expired' status will re-compute every call but dashboard/counts may drift from DB stored value; consider persisting or storing computed field.
quotations.py delete_quotation: if q is None the code silently returns {deleted: True} instead of 404 — should raise 404 for non-existent id.
quotations.py send_quotation: when customer has no email, code sends to literal string 'admin' as fallback (`cust.get('email','admin')`) — cleaner to fail-fast or use a configured no-reply address.
QuotationForm.jsx save_to_catalog: swallows product-create errors silently — user gets no feedback if catalog save fails.
gen_number(): counter seq combined with start value can produce duplicate numbers if 'start' is changed after some quotes exist (seq+start-1); consider validating start against current max.
seed_data_creation: Created quotations VMP/QTN/2026/00001..00005 during tests; one converted to order; one duplicated then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quotation module fully verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_quotations.py can be re-run standalone with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_quotations.py -o addopts='' -v`.
